title: Stable Diffusion Public Release
summary: Stability AI publicly released Stable Diffusion on August 22, 2022 following an earlier researcher release, making model weights, a model card and code available for public use.
significance: A documented public-release milestone for an openly released text-to-image generative model.

verification.note: Stability AI's public-release post is dated August 22 and explicitly announces the public release of Stable Diffusion, while linking the model weights, model card and code. A later Stability AI retrospective explicitly identifies August 22, 2022 as the co-release date with researchers from LMU Munich and Runway ML. No development geography, training geography, ancestry, influence, causality or relationships are inferred.

sources.title: Celebrating one year(ish) of Stable Diffusion … and what a year it’s been!

candidateMeta.admissionReason: First-party release evidence directly supports the August 22, 2022 public-release milestone, and a later first-party retrospective explicitly corroborates that date and the co-release context.
